content:
## GTA 6 Squeaks Into The Game Awards 2026 Eligibility

The mega-game of this generation, Grand Theft Auto 6, has made headlines once again. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, GTA 6 will be eligible for The Game Awards 2026 by a matter of one day.

### A Narrow Window for Qualification

The Game Awards maintains strict eligibility cutoff dates for games released within a specific timeframe each year. For a title as massive and anticipated as GTA 6, cutting it so close to the deadline adds an extra layer of excitement and drama for the gaming community and industry analysts alike.

### Can It Break Records?

Securing eligibility is only the first step. Speculation naturally arises around how the game will perform at the ceremony. Observers are already wondering if it has what it takes to challenge or even break the record number of wins previously set by Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. While the hype is unprecedented, the actual competition and critical reception will ultimately dictate its success at the event.

### Editor's Take

Qualifying for TGA 2026 by just a single day is a thrilling technicality for the biggest game of the generation. While we must wait to see how it performs against the competition, this narrow squeak-in guarantees that the upcoming awards season will be one for the history books.
